pokedexEntries.rb: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey’s bones.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its steel-like hide adds to its powerful tackle. Its horns are so hard, they can pierce a diamond.

pokedexEntries.go: It swings its big tail around during battle. If its foe flinches, it will charge with its sturdy body.

pokedexEntries.si: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can snap the victim’s spine quite easily.

pokedexEntries.cr: It uses its thick arms, legs and tail to attack forcefully. Melee combat is its specialty.

pokedexEntries.rs: NIDOKING’s thick tail packs enormously destructive power. With one swing, it can topple a metal transmission tower. Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

pokedexEntries.fr: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

pokedexEntries.lg: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey’s bones.

pokedexEntries.dpp: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

pokedexEntries.ss: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

pokedexEntries.sw: When it goes on a rampage, it’s impossible to control. But in the presence of a Nidoqueen it’s lived with for a long time, Nidoking calms down.
